subjects.description: A yellow taxi cab, photographed rather than rendered, its bodywork carrying the wear of daily service.
subjects.appearance_details: Deep gloss yellow lacquer with fine swirl marks from machine washing, road film greying the lower doors and sills, a stone-chipped leading edge, chrome trim dulled and pitted, window glass carrying soft reflections of the buildings alongside, tyres matte black with damp sidewalls.
subjects.position: Follows the position given by the control signal.

subjects.description: Surrounding road traffic sharing the carriageway.
subjects.appearance_details: Automotive paint in muted greys and dark blues with realistic specular falloff, glass reflecting sky and facades, rubber and plastic trim reading as distinct materials from the painted panels, brake lights glowing warm against the daylight.
subjects.position: Follows the positions given by the control signal.

background_setting: A downtown avenue of mid-rise buildings in glass, painted brick and weathered concrete, each material distinct in reflectance. Asphalt shows aggregate grain, worn lane markings, tar seams and damp patches that mirror the sky. Street furniture, signage and foliage carry photographic surface detail and appropriate wear.

lighting.conditions: Bright overcast daylight, the sky acting as a large soft source
lighting.direction: High and slightly behind camera, raking across the roadway
lighting.shadows: Soft-edged contact shadows beneath vehicles, grounding them to the road surface
lighting.illumination_effect: Even diffuse illumination with tight specular highlights on paintwork, glass and wet asphalt, and gentle aerial haze with distance

aesthetics.composition: As given by the control signal
aesthetics.color_scheme: Saturated yellow against desaturated urban greys and blues, warm red and amber accents from lamps and signage
aesthetics.visual_texture: Photographic microdetail throughout: asphalt aggregate, brick mortar, glass smears, paint imperfection and tyre tread

cinematography.framing: As given by the control signal
cinematography.camera_angle: As given by the control signal

style_medium: Live-action video captured on a full-frame digital cinema camera

actions.description: Vehicles travel along the avenue at speed, their motion, spacing and camera framing following the control signal exactly; light plays across the paintwork as they move.

segments.description: A brief continuous shot of traffic moving along a downtown avenue in overcast daylight.
segments.key_changes: Lighting on the vehicle surfaces shifts as they travel; the structure of the scene follows the control signal.

temporal_caption: Across four seconds, traffic moves along a downtown avenue under bright overcast light. Reflections travel across the vehicles' paintwork and glass as they pass, contact shadows stay locked beneath the wheels, and the wet asphalt holds a soft mirror of the sky.
audio_description: Engine note and tyre roar on damp asphalt, the wash of passing vehicles, and the low rumble of city traffic. No dialogue or music.
